landing.faqQ1: Are the questions really based on the official K53 test?
landing.faqA1: They are written from the National Road Traffic Act, its regulations and the official Department of Transport sign chart — not copied from another app. Road signs are verified against that chart before they reach you.
landing.faqQ2: Is it really once-off — no subscription trap?
landing.faqA2: Yes. {price} once-off unlocks everything for 90 days. Nothing renews automatically, we keep no card on file, and there is no monthly plan to cancel — when the 90 days end, access simply stops.
landing.faqQ3: My teen will use it — what about their data?
landing.faqA3: The free readiness test is anonymous — the result is kept on your own device and nothing is sent to us without an account. We collect the minimum personal information needed and never store biometrics.
landing.faqQ4: Does it work on my phone?
landing.faqA4: Yes. It runs in any browser on your phone, tablet or computer — there is nothing to download from an app store.
landing.faqQ5: Can I use it in Afrikaans?
landing.faqA5: The app interface is bilingual — switch between English and Afrikaans at any time from the top bar. The questions and lessons themselves are in English for now; the Afrikaans content is being written.
landing.ctaBandTitle: 5 questions. 30 seconds. Know where you stand.
landing.ctaBandSub: No download, no sign-up. See your readiness score instantly.
landing.coachTitle1: Every app gives you a score.
landing.coachBody: After the free test, your AI Coach reads the result like a tutor would: it shows which signs you confused, explains why, scores your readiness, and hands you the exact next lesson. Parents get a score they can actually read.
landing.coachBullet1: Sees why you got it wrong — not just that you did

mock.title: Mock exam
mock.subtitle: A full K53-style paper. Three sections, each scored on its own — you must pass all three.
mock.rule1: {count} questions across three sections: Rules of the Road, Road Signs, and Vehicle Controls.
mock.rule2: Each section is scored separately. Failing one section fails the whole exam.
mock.rule3: No feedback during the exam — you find out how you did at the end.
mock.rule4: Questions come in a fixed order, one at a time. You can change your answer until you tap Next — after that you cannot return to it, and you cannot skip ahead. The real test works the same way.
mock.timerHint: Recommended for a realistic run. The exam submits automatically when time runs out.
